briefs.arena-l02: SaaS landing page (1440, dark): hero with product screenshot card, logo row, three feature sections alternating image/text, pricing three tiers with a highlighted middle, FAQ six items, footer with four columns.
briefs.arena-m04: Three screens (375×812 each): welcome with illustration placeholder and two buttons; sign-up form (name, email, password, terms checkbox, submit); home feed after sign-up with a greeting, three cards and a bottom tab bar.
